content: No, that is not true. In Switzerland, terminating a rental agreement is governed by the Swiss Code of Obligations (Obligationenrecht, OR) and cantonal regulations. The notice period for residential rentals is typically three months, not one month, and it must be given in writing (usually by registered mail or in person) to be valid. An email alone is generally not sufficient to meet the legal requirements for termination. Additionally, the specific terms of the lease agreement and local cantonal law may apply, so it is important to consult the lease contract and local regulations or seek legal advice.
